positions.name: OwnedVersusRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: what is the distinction between intelligence you keep and intelligence you rent?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same directional read: an antithesis that separates what is owned and retained (owned intelligence, perspective as asset) from what is commodified and rented (rented intelligence, substrate as commodity). They share the same aphoristic-technical register, matched oppositional syntax, market-pricing relational frame, and autonomy value signal — one coherent stance performed the same way across two maxims.
